extracted.intended_audience: patrons and performers of the Laugh Factory Long Beach (audience members, ticket buyers, and comedians submitting content)
extracted.subtask_description: Operational policies and visitor-facing requirements for shows at the Laugh Factory Long Beach, including ticketing, on-site purchase rules, parking/payment options, content submission instructions, and privacy/consent notices. Useful for attendees planning visits and performers/content creators interacting with the venue/site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule and lineup subject to change
rubrics_metrics.description: Prices, performers, and schedule are subject to change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated across event listings as a general disclaimer that show details may be altered. No further scheduling guarantees provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-drink minimum requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: A two-drink minimum purchase per patron is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated as a condition for attendance; appears on each show listing as a mandatory on-site purchase requirement for patrons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vouchers not redeemable at the door
rubrics_metrics.description: Vouchers are not redeemable at the door.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit policy about voucher redemption — patrons cannot redeem vouchers upon arrival at the club.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parking — Valet service available
rubrics_metrics.description: VALET SERVICE IN FRONT OF THE CLUB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides on-site valet as the stated parking option; no additional parking rules or fees are listed on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted payment methods
rubrics_metrics.description: WE ACCEPT: CASH, CARDS , APPLE PAY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists the payment forms accepted by the venue for purchases; no mention of other digital wallets or contactless alternatives beyond Apple Pay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content submission for membership/feature
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your best content, jokes, photos, or videos to become an exclusive Laugh Factory member and have your content shared on our website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invites users to submit material for consideration; implies selection for membership/feature but does not specify submission rules, content standards, ownership/rights, or moderation criteria on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social login privacy and consent
rubrics_metrics.description: We'll never post to Facebook without your permission. We will access Facebook to get and use your email address, friend list, interests, likes and public profile, which includes your name, profile picture, user ID, age range, gender, networks, language, country and your other public info. See our Privacy Policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains the data the site will access via Facebook login and promises not to post without permission; points users to the Privacy Policy for more details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cookie consent
rubrics_metrics.description: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized content, and analyze our traffic. By clicking "Accept All", you consent to our use of cookies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page provides cookie choices (Learn more, Decline, Accept All) and a brief rationale for cookie use; acts as an explicit consent mechanism for site analytics and personalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright and trademark restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: This website is protected by U.S. and International copyright laws. Reproduction and distribution of content, with or without modification, without written permission of Laugh Factory Inc., is prohibited. Laugh Factory, LaughFactory.com, the Laugh Factory logo, and all media posted have proprietary rights and are registered as trademarks and copyrights, of Laugh Factory Inc., or its affiliates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States legal restrictions on reuse of site content and trademarks, includes corporate contact/address for rights holder. No permissive reuse terms are provided on the page.
